reviews.author: Kati Davis
reviews.text: We were out of town and broke down on the highway. They came and help get us into the gas station safely! After we were safely parked they went ABOVE AND BEYOND., they actually took my husband to the part store and fixed our car right there ! What could have been several hour delay of even days was only a very short time. The price for the service they provided could never be beat ! If you're questioning if you should use them please do I'd be willing to bet you wouldn't be disappointed!

reviews.author: Jocelyn Rosa
reviews.text: Mr. Harris has done an amazing job with helping me and my family get back on the road. He made magic happen with the grace of God. Will recommend to anyone that needs help. He's the one you need. Reasonable prices and an amazing job on get us back on the road to Philadelphia, PA. Thank you Mr. Harris Forever grateful for your services.

reviews.author: Ashley Suszczewicz
reviews.text: My jeep broke down and Harris towing was super fast to come and help bring it back to my house. The owner was very friendly. I would definitely call him agian. The price was better then everyone else locally too. Definitely support your local businesses!

reviews.author: Master Services
reviews.text: Very professional! I Having a break down is always stressful but when it happens to you, must happen next to a very busy interstate, it's so much worse. Carl got my car on the truck quickly and we were on the road, Carl drove excellently and was a real pleasure to talk to on the trip back home. He dropped off the car perfectly and even gave me some very good tips on what may have causes the issue with the car, Thank you so much.

reviews.author: Krissi B
reviews.text: Karl Harris and Harris Family Towing came through on the spur of the moment to tow my truck from Route 2 at the busiest time of the day when my tire blew and I had no spare. He even drove it into the bay for me because my nerves wouldn’t let me. Plus, pricing was affordable! I Appreciate it and will recommend to anyone!! Thanks again

reviews.author: Katie Lynch
reviews.text: These lovely folks helped me when I ran out of gas on an off ramp. They had somebody there with gas within 20 minutes and had me on my way. Thank you!!!

reviews.author: Mickala Berta
reviews.text: While in Doswell Va for work our car’s gas tank was vandalized, we used Harris Family Towing to get our car to a local shop. Karl was beyond helpful during this stressful situation. He got to us very quickly, was very kind, and went out of his way to send up an update and picture of our car when he parked at the repair shop. I highly recommend using Harris family towing if you are in need of help in Doswell and the surrounding Va area!

reviews.author: Nakeem Brown
reviews.text: This company (crooks) towed(STOLE) a Honda accord I left at a truck stop with permission from store manager. They claimed someone from the store called them and said the car was abandoned(LIE). They stole the car between 12-27-21 (monday night) and 12-28-21 (early Tuesday morning) By Tuesday at 10am they had already took the car to the junk yard and cut the catalytic converter. ( what legitimate company tows an abandoned car and disposes of it the same day? ) What legitimate company would offer to return the car free of charge, but wanted to make sure we canceled the stolen report before returning the car? When the car is towed back to the truck stop the glove box lock is broken. The locks for the trunk were also broken . He also put an after catalytic converter inside the car and claimed it came off of my Honda accord. The cuts didn't even match. He was arrested immediately after unloading the car. I don't believe this is the 1st time they've done this.

reviews.author: Pam Sweeney
reviews.text: I highly recommend this company! A family member was in a bind and needed their car towed first thing in the morning. I called and spoke with Karl and he was extremely kind and professional. Thank you again!

reviews.author: Shelaywa Harkless
reviews.text: Harris towing came to the rescue on a Sunday football afternoon!! When no other tow truck came he came!! He towed us 2 exits and fixed our car we were on our way back to New York he waited patiently in the rain with us while his other family member went minutes away to get the parts we needed!! He could’ve over charged us due to our circumstances and the wether!!! But he didn’t!! We appreciate the service u gave us you went over and beyond for total strangers!! Luv shay n Andy from Brooklyn ny!!

reviews.author: Kevin Baigent
reviews.text: I drive an 300zx and its a very old and low car. They took the time to show concern for my front bumper when i sent them a picture for reference so i was able to take the bumper off prior to their arrival to prevent any damages to facilitate their Wonderful and timely service. I would reccomend anyone to use them and support a local family owned business.

reviews.author: Terry Richardson
reviews.text: This Family owned and operated business is second to none in my book. They came out in 23° weather and stayed with me for over two hours trying to fix an issue and they never gave up. I wish they were closer to me in my hometown of Luray Virginia I was traveling I was over two hours from home I had been pushing snow for three days exhausted and wore out. This family is top-notch second to none please give them a buzz

reviews.author: Wesley Pierre
reviews.text: I was lock out my truck at the flying j and they came and got me back in my truck in rapid time and great price.

reviews.author: Ashli Griffith
reviews.text: Karl was very nice, he was on time and very friendly... I would definitely recommend him if you need cars out your yard... Family business can’t go wrong with that!!

reviews.author: Beth Poppas
reviews.text: So thankful for Karl last evening coming to change my tire when I ran over a nail on 95. Thank you for quickly responding and getting me back on the road with my spare

reviews.author: Margaret Bailey
reviews.text: The service was wonderful. I need to put a vehicle in the container and Harris found creative means to get the job done. Thanks Harris Towing.

reviews.author: Lamar Washington
reviews.text: Professional, friendly, and great service. Towed a vehicle for my father to the mechanic shop with ease. Highly suggested

reviews.author: Marie Marion
reviews.text: This company hands down is amazing came in my time of need . Didn't take advantage of me being a girl an charge me what ever there is still good people in this world thank u

reviews.author: Ronald Boisvert
reviews.text: They helped me out of a tight spot on a Sunday night when no other service would. Great service. 100% recommendation.

reviews.author: Terrance Mosley
reviews.text: Very timely and professional. Thank you Karl Harris for naming my stressful situation more bearable. I recommend this co. To anyone in need

reviews.author: Sherelle Smith Mungo
reviews.text: the best prices in the city!! Respectful,helpful,on time and a man of his word I’ll definitely recommend his services to anyone.

reviews.author: Candice Smith
reviews.text: Excellent service, 5 star rating on time service. Friendly and very professional definitely recommend others.

reviews.author: monica moon
reviews.text: As soon as I called him he was there to help. Professional and dependable and I’m sure I will be using his services again
